name: Bearclaw
theme: A savage northern berserker who fights with bear-like strength, survives punishment, and overwhelms powerful enemies through brutal close combat and relentless aggression.
visualIdentity: Massive fur-lined armor, broad greataxe, bear pelt mantle, iron-plated leather, carved rage totems, weathered battle gear, and restrained amber rage effects.
consistency: Use the same face, hairstyle, fur mantle, greataxe design, armor silhouette, totem design, leather bindings, and brown, iron, amber, and dark fur palette across all assets.

starterAbilities.name: Berserker Rage
starterAbilities.description: Unleash primal fury to increase offensive pressure.

starterAbilities.name: Bear's Ferocity
starterAbilities.description: Channel raw bear-like strength to overpower enemies.

starterAbilities.name: Devastating Strike
starterAbilities.description: Deliver a crushing blow capable of staggering powerful foes.
